AppLocale FAQ

Does AppLocale implement Control Nearby Devices or remote-control APIs?

No. We deliver Connect listing metadata copy only — name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot caption lines. Control Nearby Devices API integration, Wi-Fi peer discovery, and remote navigation overlay engineering are outside scope.

How is Control Nearby Devices listing copy different from Switch Control or AssistiveTouch?

Control Nearby Devices listing copy covers remotely operating another nearby Apple device on the same Wi-Fi and Apple Account — media play/pause, Home Screen, App Switcher, Notification Center, Control Center, Siri, and volume from iPhone. Switch Control covers external switch input and scanning on the local device. AssistiveTouch covers the floating on-screen assistive menu. How is this different from Guided Access, Voice Control, or Universal Control?

Control Nearby Devices covers same-account Wi-Fi remote navigation to a nearby Apple device — a different buyer story on each surface.
